Okay I cannot leave this place looking like this, I don't care if we're only here for three more hours. It's going to drive me insane the whole time we're waiting.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?

Honestly? I would have talked to people sooner. I think I would have made it clearer earlier that this was a team and not just four people surviving in the same location. Because we almost were just four people surviving in the same location, and that's scarier than any of the actual survival stuff.

I think that's actually what got us through, honestly. Not just the rationing and the raft frame and the signal equipment — though all of that mattered, it really did. But also the fact that we kept being people to each other. Even when it was hard. Even when we were bad at it.
